title: Saving clause.
bodyText: This chapter does not prevent the recognition under principles of comity or otherwise of a foreign-country judgment not within the scope of this chapter.
bodyHtml: [§658F-10]  Saving clause.  This chapter does not prevent the recognition under principles of comity or otherwise of a foreign-country judgment not within the scope of this chapter. [L 2009, c 34, pt of §1]
